draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.98, the 169th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 18th of 25 at RB. He went 184th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (20th percentile), 10-yard split (13th percentile). College production: 1,266 rushing yards in 2024, 12th of 25 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Minnesota Vikings (practice squad). 10 career games and 3 starts over 1 completed season. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Weak spots: yards per carry 3.6 (13th percentile), broken tackles 3 (22nd percentile). Played 10 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 running back who played: 310 scrimmage yards against a median of 267, above the norm.
